# TimecodeField

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTimecodeField` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTimecodeField.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTimecodeField.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasTimecodeField.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A timecode `HH:MM:SS:FF` to enter or show: segments stepped by the arrow keys, digits filling from the right, `+`/`-` offsets, a large read-only readout for a transport bar

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasTimecodeField](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTimecodeField.md)
- [UltraCanvasTheme](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTheme.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTimecodeField> CreateTimecodeField(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTimecodeField(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onCommit` | `std::function<void(long long frames)> onCommit` | Enter, a step, focus leaving with a valid entry |
